model.form: Weibull + log-normal mixture on log-area z = ln A
model.weight_convention: pi_W weights the WEIBULL; the 2015 paper's c weights the LOG-NORMAL, so c = 1 - pi_W
model.grain: one area per group (group_single_entry), column area_corr
model.truncation: hard, at the per-survey threshold_MSH in reference_groups_2026-10/survey_calibration.csv (lifetime_divergence threshold, trunc_factor 10)

data_lineage: Sunspot-derived only: per-survey group areas and their calibration. No isotope, aurora, proxy or SILSO input (ADR-002).
